vo.en: Take your middle finger and fold it under until the knuckle touches the desk.

vo.en: Press your other fingers down. Now, try to lift only your ring finger. It won't budge.

vo.en: But here’s the creepy part—your hand is physically locked. Your brain is shouting, but your body isn't listening.

vo.en: It’s a biological glitch. Your middle and ring fingers are actually tethered by a shared tendon.

vo.en: When the middle finger is pinned, it anchors that connection, trapping the ring finger in place.
